text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Facing rivals turning into monsters before my eyes, I thought, I trained, and so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Weapons and will.
A sharp, piercing finishing spurt that never misses a chance for victory.
And a heart brimming with pride, never doubting its own coronation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Armed with those two things, Satono Crown
splendidly emerged as the champion of the Kyoto Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOO!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crownーー!!
What an incredible, incredible final spurtーー!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOH!!
Show us more of that true 'Satono' power
from here on out toooo!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Everyone, thank you so much for your support!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(I felt it, for sure.
...And now I'm certain!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Yes, I'm... only just getting started—!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
How did you find me today?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Thank you. —I feel the exact same way myself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
A lot has happened, but even so,
we never stopped thinking.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Because I never stopped preparing...
I've gained something certain here and now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I've got a grasp on it.
We've... grown stronger.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Hey, give me your hand, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes, just like that! —...Hup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown firmly gripped the hand
I had just raised in confusion.
Her hand and mine formed two large, united fists.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Do you see? It's right here.
It's what you and I were able to grasp together.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Can you tell? ...It's burning hot, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...It's hot, and strong.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
However, from now on, it'll get even stronger, even hotter.
—Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, still a long way to go...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Looks like you're having a fulfilling time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san!
You came to watch?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: What should be seen, I will see.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "So, I saw everything. Your strength. And your run today."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: From here on out, though, there was nothing left to do but surpass it.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember the conversation
we had after last year's Japanese Derby?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
So you've come to block my path, Satono Crown.
...Then I'll just have to defeat you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"It's time to battle.
A fight for the crown, to see who's the strongest—the Spring Grand Prix—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —At the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...You're being awfully pushy, you know.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: That was your plan, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Geez. Having someone you understand so well
can really be a double-edged sword sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
...May I decide on our next goal?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's go take on the Takarazuka Kinen!
Yeah. Let's head for the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
OK!
Shall we have a match, Duramente-san?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...I will leave no room for regret.
I will definitely win, and this year, I will go to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
This year, without fail.
I will make the name Duramente known to the world.
The name of the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After parting ways with Duramente.
Satono Crown, who seemed lost in thought for a while, then—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —"To the world."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She murmured softly.
Out of the blue, yet with absolute certainty,
those words left her lips.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You're right. In truth...
Maybe I've been thinking about that from the very beginning.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainer, I told you, didn't I?
That 'I want to bring the greatest glory to the Satono name.'"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "The cherished dream our predecessors chased but could not achieve... Winning a GⅠ in the Twinkle Series, and not just that."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I swore I'd become the kind of great Umamusume
that would make people say,
"Satono is the pride of the racing world."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Trainer. For that reason too, I—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I'm setting my sights on the “world.”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Fufu. In the end, maybe this is just a matter of my pride, or rather, my stubbornness.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I mean, just now, when Duramente-san
mentioned the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
When I imagined her reigning supreme on the throne,
making the name of 'the strongest' resound across the world, I...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Because I just couldn't "let it slide."
choice_data_list: ...The crown will always belong to you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
!
...Right.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Trainer.
Not just Duramente-san.
Any world-renowned Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I won't yield. Never.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I will be the only one to hold aloft the crown of supremacy—!
choice_data_list: So you're heading for the world stage, huh.
So you're heading for the world stage, huh.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...Let us head there, you and I.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
And I will become one. An illustrious Umamusume
who makes the Satono name resonate across the world!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A heavy shudder runs through my body.
Awe. Anticipation. Anxiety. Fighting spirit.
Borne from something containing all of these.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still, a nod is given.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's take on the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, I can't help but answer.
Because...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because her shining eyes are always, so intensely,
fixated on nothing but glory.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...And just when we had gotten all fired up
for what lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: That said, any overseas expedition will have to wait until after the spring season at least.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, once we boarded the highway bus
returning to the academy from Kyoto Racecourse,
Satono Crown said to me:

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I need to settle things with Duramente-san, and... above all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Did you see it?
This press conference.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I immediately open the URL sent by Satono Crown.
What appears on the screen is—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—Yes!
The next race that I, Kitasan Black,
will be aiming for is...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai, the Tenno Sho (Spring),
and the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Oooh...?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
K-Kitasan Black-san!
Does that mean you're going to challenge
the Senior Spring Triple Crown... then!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "...I know it's incredibly difficult. Even Mejiro McQueen fell just short of achieving that great feat."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's precisely why!
I have to be the one to do it!!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Please watch!
Witness the greatest festival that no one has ever seen before!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I swear...!! I'll stir up a storm in the Spring Senior Triple Crown
festival with me as the star...!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“—Before the Takarazuka Kinen,
let us head to the Osaka Hai first.”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Guess it's about time I went and said hello to this monster of a girl.
